rv.q: Every last production decision made for Sparked is nothing short of exceptional.
Director Cameron Watson's six-person cast deliver equal parts charm and skill and humor.

Playwright Younger blends fact, fiction, and speculation in the cleverest of ways, while featuring a diverse mix of straight and gay characters who may or may not be destined to a happily ever after, and so what if a certain scene breaks the rules he’s established. It’s an entertaining detour into sci-fi territory so I went with it.
The desire to be fully seen is at the heart of the play, and the characters become so through a generous script that gives them all nuance and clarity, as well as pitch-perfect casting and acting.
Working in tandem, director Cameron Watson, the ensemble, and the tech designers deliver an enticing production that mines Younger's humor and pathos with equal assurance.
Though he wrote 'Rorschach' 17 years ago, it feels fresh in this production, a collaboration between playwright and director in bringing it to magical life for the first time.

Rorschach has all the raw visual tools and a few brilliant performances to make for an engaging evening, but until the dialogue stops leaning on stagecraft, the emotional picture remains out of focus.
